notes.title: Banter v1.0-1462
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Selecting a space or event from the main menu will open a details page by default. We'll add more to the page in the future. You can join the space directly using the Join button that appears on rollover.
[*] Hand raising _o/ Space moderators can now enable Hand Raising from the Space Settings page, for events that use a Q&A format. All other users will then find a Raise Hand button on the Space Settings page. The People Here list will show who has their hand raised, in the order that they raised. Space moderators can then clear the hand raise status when it is each users' turn to speak.
[*] Y'all ready to Bust some Blocks?
[*] People Here list hopefully fixed for reals this time
[*] All Friends list no longer limited to 50 friends
[/list]

notes.title: Banter v1.0 (1419)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Improved piloting/vehicle-player attachment
[*] Added Anchor option to controls settings
[*] Added physics settings to SDK scene settings
[*] Added support for leaderboards to SDK
[*] Fixed bug with People Here menu and instancing
[*] Set blendshape default values to 0 instead of 0.5
[/list]

notes.title: Banter v.10 (1388)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Users launching Banter via Quest or Steam will now be displayed using their platform username and avatar image when they are not signed in to Sidequest.
[*] Guest users on Meta accounts that are designated as Adult will no longer be muted, and we assume adult for Steam users so Steam guests will also be able to talk by default.
[*] Private Instances buttons added to the Space Settings screen. This allows you to create a private instance of the space you are in, which you can invite friends to.
[*] Movement (left stick) deadzone settings added to controls options.
[*] Hand Tracking Locomotion option added to controls settings. You must be in HandTracking control mode to use Hand Tracking Locomotion.
[/list]

notes.title: Banter v1.0 (1373)

[*] Loads of smaller bugfixes
[/list]

notes.title: Banter v1.0 (1334)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Introducing the new Quick Menu, initially for VR and supported controllers only:
[list]

[*] Click left thumbstick to open/close the menu, and to move back through submenus.
[*] Use direct touch (initially right-hand only) to navigate and press menu items.
[*] New Emoji function: Choose an emoji from the menu and it'll appear above your head for everyone else for a few seconds :poop: 
[*] Some quick settings, more will be added in future!
[*] Control custom user blendshapes on avatars that have them!
[*] Add your own custom menus in your scenes via the SDK (release to follow), hook up buttons, toggles and sliders to Visual Scripting events and variables!
[*] More to come!
[/list]
[list]

notes.title: Banter v0.0.600
notes.content:
[list]
[*] A ton of behind-the-scenes changes to support the new V2 space building SDK coming soon.
[*] New space loading experience, and you'll now load straight into your Home space by default.
[*] You can set any space as your Home space in the Settings menu, or choose Default (a private version of the old Lobby space) or Banter Choice (a home space set by us at SideQuest, which may change periodically)
[*] Voice chat rolloff distance option - you'll find this in audio settings (headphones icon in settings page)
[*] Brand-spankin' new portal design! 
[/list]

Couple of notes from the devs: 
- You will need to update to this build in order to see and communicate with other players. 
- This new version of Banter contains sweeping changes under the hood and it's possible that you'll hit some bugs. We'll get all that cleared up in the coming days.
